long_document_evaluation.summary: Solaria Technologies was founded in Zurich in 2012 by Dr. Elena Ramos to pioneer clean energy storage solutions. In fiscal year 2025, Solaria achieved record revenues of 340 million euros with an operating margin of 18.5 percent. Supply bottlenecks in critical lithium imports and geopolitical tariffs increased raw component procurement overhead by 14 percent. The strategic roadmap plans to construct a gigafactory in Valencia by 2028 and expand commercial operations across Latin America. The company is based in Zurich, Switzerland, but has offices in Valencia, Barcelona, Madrid, and New York. It has a workforce of more than 2,000 people and employs more than 1,000 in Switzerland, Spain, and the U.S. It also has operations in Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Mexico, Argentina and the United States, and plans to expand its operations across the world by the end of the decade.
